name: Apostles' Creed
coreDoctrines: Jesus Christ as Lord, conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of Mary
Christ's suffering, death, descent, resurrection, and ascension
the holy catholic Church and communion of saints
resurrection of the body and life everlasting
guardsAgainst: forgetting forgiveness as central to Christian confession
spiritualizing hope away from bodily resurrection
isolating faith from the communion of saints
discernmentQuestions: Does this fit the basic grammar of Christian confession?
Does it honor creation, incarnation, forgiveness, and resurrection?
Does it draw the believer into the communion of the Church rather than isolation?
